reviewScope: Read-only local audit of artifacts/ar-retention-cohort-20261009 retained benchmark data; no live contacts, source edits, or deployment.

noGo.reason: Explicit access-denied/403; candidate visit skipped under no-automatic-retry policy. Excluded from usable-pair denominator.

aRoInventory.publicRegistrationConfirmation: 0 confirmed Accept and 0 confirmed Reject registrations in each version.
notes: Segment candidate inventory is partial due a fuller capture surfacing unresolved visible #truste-show-consent / Do Not Sell My Personal Information; Accept and Reject states match baseline.
Spotify exposes only Your Privacy Choices (do_not_sell_share), not an A/R banner.

retention.comparisonLimit: Different live request streams; do not infer retention improvement from 13 versus 15 drops.

latency.recordedInterpretation: candidate minus baseline; Segment is +3344 ms under this orientation.
latency.gate: Not passed: recorded p95 exceeds the 2000 ms target.
latency.formulaCheck: analyze.mts binds b=baseline and a=candidate, then computes a.durationMs - b.durationMs; this matches the stored candidate-minus-baseline deltas.

packets.eligibleActionDenominators: Accept 2/2 clicks and Reject 1/1 click per version; these are activation counts, not registration confirmation.
packets.executionMeaning: succeeded means verified click plus completed bounded observation; succeeded_with_confirmation separately requires a verified consent decision.

ownedCanaries.originalRunArtifactCollision: Both original paths shared an output directory; testar2 overwrote testar1 raw files. The two original testar1 packets remain honestly missing and are not counted as raw-packet-verified.

reject.inFlightBoundary: The retained analytics request began 1 ms before refusal registration and was excluded from post-refusal activity.

freshTestar1Repair.limitations: The Accept packet's auxiliary form-capture subobject is Limited/window_ended; its canonical action projection remains succeeded_with_confirmation.

ownedCanaries.testar2Accept: Unconfirmed in both candidate run and baseline-adapted fixture test; retained page prose expecting confirmation is not receipt evidence. Do not override missing verified grant proof.
ownedCanaries.fixtureTests: Candidate-owned fixture tests pass 4/5; frozen-baseline-adapted tests pass 4/5 with the same testar2 Accept unconfirmed-versus-confirmed assertion failure. The initial baseline attempt's ENOENT was a fixture-path issue, not a semantic result.

contacts.missingPacketScope: The overwritten original testar1 Accept and Reject packets; fresh repair packets are separate validated samples.
contacts.centralPersistence: 63 contacts persisted for the public/original-owned run and 3 persisted for the owned repair run, per contact-persist.log and owned-repair-persist.log.

baselineDisposition: Do not promote the prior-working baseline or make production/population claims from this diagnostic cohort.
